statements.t: • Revenue excluding the Company's largest customer reached a record $1,627,444 , up 61% from $1,010,243 in the prior-year quarter and up 11% from $1,463,319 in the first quarter, exceeding the greater-than-10% sequential growth outlook provided in July.
On October 20, 2026, the Company announced an expansion of the program, with cost and cash savings expected to exceed $350,000 per month from February 2027.

With the fiscal third quarter (September through November 2026) now at its midpoint, the Company confirms that the launch of RAIA™ remains on track for the quarter and is expected in the coming weeks.

As announced on October 20, 2026, the Company expanded its cost and cash savings program and now expects to reach monthly operating cash breakeven, defined as monthly revenue exceeding operating cash expenses excluding debt service and device builds, in January 2027, and all-in cash breakeven, which also includes debt service and device builds, in the second calendar quarter of 2027.
There can be no assurance that the Company will achieve these objectives in the periods expected or in any subsequent period, or sustain them if achieved.

Additional risks include delays or changes in the development, launch, availability or commercialization of RAIA and other products; failure of new or existing solutions to achieve anticipated customer acceptance or financial results; changes in competitive conditions or customer spending; increased working capital needs, interest expense, debt service or other cash requirements; the Company's ability to obtain…

dropped.t: Management views Q1 FY2027 as a foundational commercialization quarter in which the Company continued investing in and advancing several initiatives expected to contribute more meaningfully during the remainder of the fiscal year.

Q2 Outlook: Based on preliminary unaudited internal results, currently scheduled deployments and anticipated recurring revenue activations, management presently expects Q2 FY2027 revenue to exceed Q1 FY2027 revenue by more than 10%.
The Company currently has four contracted ROAMEO units in total and expects the two additional units to become installed, accepted and revenue-producing by the end of Q2 FY2027.

The Company's current internal forecast continues to target achieving at least one month of positive cash flow from operating activities during calendar 2026, with the objective of sustaining positive monthly operating cash flow thereafter.

There can be no assurance that the Company will achieve a positive operating cash-flow month within the anticipated period or that positive monthly operating cash flow, once achieved, will be sustained.

Information regarding June 2026 recurring monthly revenue and the Company's Q2 FY2027 outlook is preliminary, unaudited and unreviewed, is based on internal accounting records and estimates, and is subject to adjustment.

The information should not be considered a substitute for the Company's complete financial results for Q2 FY2027, which will be reported in the Company's applicable filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

There can be no assurance that SARA licenses will be activated as anticipated, that the additional ROAMEO units will be deployed or accepted during Q2, that Q2 revenue will exceed Q1 revenue by the amount currently expected, that recurring monthly revenue growth will continue, that the Company will achieve a positive operating cash-flow month during calendar 2026 or that positive monthly operating cash flow, once…
